# Use capitalized JavaScript class names and kebab-case custom element names

This is a manual naming proposal for the inspected mail widgets and protocol modules. Class/type names join capitalized words, such as NntpChannel, VCardEdit, VCardTypeSelectionComponent and BaseTreeView. Custom element registrations use stable lowercase hyphenated names such as vcard-edit, vcard-type and base-tree-view. These names are separate contracts: a component class does not have to map mechanically to every word in its tag. Preserve existing acronym spelling, registered tags and consumers. The proposal comes from current code patterns; no review in this batch demands a repository-wide acronym or filename-case conversion.

Scope: mail/widgets.
